Name: DE-Jobs
Statement:
-- +ASSIGNMENTS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Deliverable)
-- +CUSTOMFIELDS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Deliverable)
with
cut as
(
    select  a.DocumentOid as Id,
            max(isnull(convert(int, wsat.AllowPending), 0)) as AllowPending
    from    Assignment a
            join JobLookup job on job.Id = a.DocumentOid
            left join WorkflowStateAssignmentType wsat on wsat.AssignmentType = a.AssignmentType and wsat.WorkflowState = job.WorkflowState
    where   a.DocumentTypeName = 'Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Deliverable' and
            a.[User] = @CurrentUserId
    group by a.DocumentOid
),
his as 
(
    select  DocumentOid,
            string_agg(cast(Motive as varchar(max)), ',') as Motive
    from    (
                select distinct DocumentOid, Motive
                from   History with (nolock)
            ) as h
    group by DocumentOid
)
select  job.Oid as DocumentOid,
        cli.Id as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        cli.HasImage as ClientHasImage,
        prj.Id as ProjectId,
        prj.Name as Project,
        prj.Number as ProjectNumber,
        job.Oid as JobId,
        job.Subject as Job,
        job.Number as JobNumber,
        job.BusinessValue,
        pro.Oid as ProductId,
        pro.Name as Product,
        wfs.Oid as StageId,
        wfs.Name as Stage,
        wfs.Color as StageColor,
        wst.Oid as StageTypeId,
        wst.Name as StageType,
        wst.Color as StageTypeColor,
        typ.Oid as TypeId,
        typ.Name as Type,
        com.Id as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        com.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        div.Id as DivisionId,
        div.Name as Division,
        dep.Id as DepartmentId,
        dep.Name as Department,
        job.EntryDateUtc as StartDate,
        job.AgreedDateUtc as EndDate,
        par.Id as ParentId,
        par.Name as Parent,
        par.Number as ParentNumber,
        cre.Id as CreatedById,
        cre.Name as CreatedBy,
        cre.HasImage as CreatedByHasImage,
        mod.Id as ModifiedId,
        mod.Name as ModifiedBy,
        mod.HasImage as ModifiedHasImage,
        job.ModifiedOn as ModifiedOn,
        iif(bor.Oid is not null, 1, 0) as AlreadyRead,
        iif(cut.Id is null, 0, 1) as CurrentUserInTeam,
        iif(cut.AllowPending is null, 0, cut.AllowPending) as CurrentUserPending,
        iif(wfs.Delayed = 1 and job.AgreedDateUtc < cast(getdate() as date), 1, 0) as IsDelayed,
        iif(wfs.Delayed = 1 and job.AgreedDateUtc < cast(getdate() as date), datediff(day, cast(getdate() as date), job.AgreedDateUtc), null) as Delayed,
        job.Version,
        his.Motive,
        job.EstimateItem as EstimateItemId
from    Deliverable job
            join UserLookup cre on cre.Id = job.CreatedBy
            join UserLookup mod on mod.Id = job.ModifiedBy
            join ProjectLookup prj on prj.Id = job.Project
            join ClientLookup cli on cli.Id = job.Client
            left join JobLookup par on par.Id = job.Parent
            left join CommercialClientProduct pro on pro.Oid = prj.Product
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = job.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
            join JobType typ on typ.Oid = job.JobType
            join DepartmentLookup dep on dep.Id = job.Department
            join DivisionLookup div on div.Id = dep.Division
            join CompanyLookup com on com.Id = div.Company
            left join cut on cut.Id = job.Oid
            left join BaseObjectRead bor on bor.ObjectId = job.Oid and bor.ObjectType = 'Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Deliverable' and bor.[User] = @CurrentUserId
            left join his on his.DocumentOid = job.Oid
